Good morning. If you're walking into something hard today, hear this.

"Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest." Joshua 1:9 (KJV)

He didn't tell Joshua it would be easy. He told him who was going with him.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.
